name: Pil Italica Lifestyle Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, PIL Italica Lifestyle Ltd manufactures Plastic Molded furniture and other articles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
PIL is an ISO-9001:2015 accredited company, and also the only Indian company with CE certified plastic furniture products including  plastic chairs, tables, trolley, sun loungers, crates, storage bins, waste bins, etc. It has ventured into wooden furniture segment and launched several smart wooden products. It is also engaged in financing activities.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 43.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 165 days to 123 days
cons: Stock is trading at 3.33 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.72% over last 3 years.
